# Reinforcement Learning – The Seminal Papers

> A Manning Publications book by Rahul Vasant Shirale translating seminal reinforcement learning papers into runnable Python code. Chapters 1–5 are available now; later chapters are planned through 2027.

## About the Book

- **Author**: Rahul Vasant Shirale
- **Publisher**: Manning Publications
- **Expected publication**: 2027
- **GitHub repository**: https://github.com/rshirale/rl-seminal-papers
- **Companion site**: https://rshirale.github.io/rl-seminal-papers/

## What the Book Covers

The book takes a "Papers + Code" approach across 15 chapters and 3 parts:

**Part I — Foundations** (available now)
- Chapter 1: Introduction — The RL Loop & Code-First Mental Model
- Chapter 2: RL Fundamentals — MDPs, Bellman (1957), Sutton (1988), Watkins (1989)

**Part II — Deep Reinforcement Learning**
- Chapter 3: DQN — Mnih et al. (2013, 2015) (available now)
- Chapter 4: DDPG — Lillicrap et al. (2015) (available now)
- Chapter 5: PPO — Schulman et al. (2017) (available now)
- Chapter 6: SAC — Haarnoja et al. (2018) (planned)
- Chapter 7: GRPO — DeepSeek-R1 (2025) (planned)

**Part III — Real-World Applications** (planned)
- Chapter 8: AlphaGo — Silver et al. (2016)
- Chapter 9: AlphaZero — Silver et al. (2017)
- Chapter 10: RLHF — Christiano et al. (2017)
- Chapter 11: Dexterous Manipulation — Andrychowicz et al. (2019)
- Chapter 12: AlphaDev — Mankowitz et al. (2023)
- Chapter 13: Humanoid Locomotion — Radosavovic et al. (2024)
- Chapter 14: DeepSeek-R1 — RL-Only Reasoning (2025)
- Chapter 15: Conclusion — Building Your Own Experiments
